message.content:
A typical medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) contains roughly **95 calories**.  
If you’re looking at other sizes:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~149 | ~77 |
| Medium | ~182 | ~95 |
| Large | ~223 | ~116 |

So, for most everyday apples you’ll be around the 90–100 calorie mark.
